hero.description: FKHK is a student academic forum dedicated to the study, research, and development of Islamic Family Law. Together, ideas turn into real impact.

features.f1Desc: Read scientific papers, legal essays, and in-depth analyses by FKHK members on contemporary Islamic Family Law issues.
features.f2Desc: Join routine discussion circles, seminars, public debates, and enrichment programs designed to broaden legal acumen.
features.f3Desc: Register as a member, submit your academic writings, and become part of an active and productive scholarly community.

about.title: Platform for the Development of
about.quote: Ensuring love, justice, and responsibility progress together through scholarly rigor and family welfare.
about.desc: The Family Law Studies Forum (FKHK) serves as a collaborative hub for students to examine contemporary family law issues, sharpen advocacy and mediation skills, and produce actionable research for society.
about.check1: In-depth study of contemporary Islamic Family Law issues
about.check2: Publication of scholarly papers and legal opinions in reputable media
about.check3: Moot court simulations and practical advocacy training
about.check4: Community service and family legal counseling programs
about.faculty: Faculty of Sharia & Law, UIN Sunan Kalijaga
about.visiText: To become a premier student study center advancing progressive, ethical, and socially responsive Islamic Family Law scholarship.
about.misi1: Host critical and comprehensive discussion forums, weekly study circles, and legal case examinations.
about.misi2: Encourage member research productivity and publication in nationally and internationally accredited journals.
about.misi3: Facilitate practical legal skills training, including mediation, contract drafting, and moot courts.
about.misi4: Establish collaborative networks with judicial institutions, legal practitioners, scholars, and civil society.
about.misi5: Deliver legal education and family advocacy to the wider public as a form of social service.

team.heading: Together We Create
team.desc: FKHK opens wide opportunities for students seeking to excel in legal discourse, academic writing, and community advocacy.

aboutPage.divKajianDesc: Cultivating research culture, analyzing Islamic family law literature, and producing student scholarly work.
aboutPage.divAdvokasiDesc: Public legal awareness education, moot court simulations, and practical mediation capacity building.
aboutPage.divPsdmDesc: Structured member regeneration, leadership training, and academic writing proficiency.

aboutPage.historyP1: The Family Law Studies Forum was founded as an independent student forum within the Islamic Family Law Department, Faculty of Sharia and Law, UIN Sunan Kalijaga.
aboutPage.historyP2: Rooted in the need for critical, dialectical, and applied academic space, FKHK bridges classical jurisprudence (fiqh) with contemporary positive law.
aboutPage.historyP3: Through collaborative research and community advocacy, every FKHK member is prepared to be an ethical, transformative legal intellectual.
aboutPage.bgHeading: Addressing Family Law Issues Through Multidisciplinary Research
aboutPage.bgDesc: The Family Law Studies Forum (FKHK) was founded as a student platform to explore marriage law, inheritance, protection of women and children, and family dispute mediation, integrating normative legal norms with sociological realities.
aboutPage.advisorQuote: This forum exists to deepen scholarship and hone student skills in addressing increasingly intricate family law challenges in the contemporary era.
